basis: Governance: points 2 to 7 of the charter approved by Government decree No. 984 of 29 November 2011 (edition of 3 September 2019) give the Russian Federation as founder, the Government appointing the general director, and the Ministry of Culture approving large transactions and disposals of property. Red tape: the Delovoy Peterburg article of 23 May 2019 reporting the Accounts Chamber inspection.

governance.parent: Committee for Culture of Saint Petersburg

basis: Governance: the institution's activity report as of 1 January 2026 on its official documents page names it a Saint Petersburg state budgetary institution of culture with the Committee for Culture of Saint Petersburg exercising founder functions; the site now calls it the Museum and Exhibition Complex Manege.
Governance: the about page (web.archive.org copy of the foundation's own page, December 2024) calls it a charitable foundation, a non-state non-profit organisation of culture created in 1999.

Governance: the art centre's contacts page lists the Regional Public Organization Tovarishchestvo Svobodnaya Kultura under its registration details, and the about page describes the centre as a non-state, self-governing creative commune.
